name: GIRDER 格拉德 Arrow press-fit T700/T800 105 Di2
why_interesting: The earlier official Arrow generation remains listed beside the 2025 bike with a different frame, bottom bracket, sizing, weight and price; it is kept separate so buyers can identify which Arrow a seller offers.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 2×12; FC-R7100 52-36T 170 mm crank, CS-R7100 11-36T cassette, CN-M7100 chain
facts.frame: Earlier Arrow T700 + T800 carbon aero frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, fully internal routing
facts.frame_material: T700 + T800 carbon frame and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded aero frame and fork with internal routing and press-fit bottom bracket
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: Press-fit shell per manufacturer; supplied ceramic-bearing BB is described as 'PF386 to T47 tool compatible', so confirm the exact shell standard before ordering parts
facts.wheels: Adler Augen wavy-rim carbon wheels with ceramic bearings, 50 mm front / 60 mm rear
facts.tires: Maxxis 700C×28C with TPU inner tubes fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: T700 + T800 integrated carbon handlebar with internal routing
facts.seatpost: Not specified; Selle Italia saddle and bar tape listed
facts.sizes: S (476 mm), M (503 mm), L (533 mm); the size dimension is not labelled
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this 105 Di2 complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
facts.community_build_context: Public XHS Arrow listings also name mechanical 7020 and 7120 builds. Historical used or condition-qualified asking prices of CNY 4,999 (2025-11-26) and CNY 5,350 (2026-09-09) are different-build references; neither identifies this frame generation or prices this Di2 trim.
facts.historical_owner_context: One Arrow owner in February 2023 reported a purchase a little over CNY 10,000 and arranging shop assembly and adjustment after delivery. The exact generation and 105 configuration are unknown; confirm current delivery and assembly terms with the seller rather than treating this as a policy for this trim.

official_price.price_basis: Manufacturer-listed price on the exact ROAD-section ARROW page; no mainland marketplace listing or checkout amount was observed

source_note: The official ROAD-section ARROW page lists the T700 + T800 press-fit generation with 105 Di2 at 9.1 kg and ¥14,800. A 2024 exhibitor profile describes an Arrow with a mechanical Shimano 2×12 group, so seller listings may mix builds. The 2025 T47/UDH frame, geometry and weight do not apply to this generation.
price_status: Official CNY 14,800 list price observed 2026-10-23; no marketplace listing or checkout amount verified
